newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil weakens on futures, premiums holding.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil weakens on futures, premiums holding.

text.p: NWE gas oil was knocked lower on Wednesday as softer futures hit outright prices. Premiums were broadly steady.
May IPE gas oil was trading $2.25 a tonne lower at $163 at 1200 GMT on the back of bearish APIs.
Interest for diesel was expected to hold pride of place again today with premiums for cargoes pegged around May IPE +$12 cif NWE.
Barges were also looking strong with offers of May IPE +$11 fob ARA, although buying interest was only seen around May IPE +$9-9.50 fob.
Heating oil cargoes were assessed around May IPE +$4-5 cif NWE for both FOD and DIN, but there was very little talk on either.
"FOD is just not being discussed," said one trader.
The heating oil barge market was muted with second half April bid around May IPE +25-50 cents fob ARA and offered at +$1 with first half May at similar numbers.
